description.en: Section titles come from Hydraulic engineering; the S-tube large end seal and small end seal figures stay the printed ones. An S-tube seal from Hebei Pinjin Machinery is a set for one end of the S-tube. Large end and small end are both on the same product page and they are not interchangeable rows. No pump model is named.
description.zh: 节标题来自《液压工程》，S-tube large end seal and small end seal的数字仍是已印数字。河北品锦机械的 S 管密封是 S 管一端用的套件。大端和小端写在同一张产品页上，但不是可以互换的行。没有点名泵型号。

h1.en: Hydraulic engineering sets the order for the S-tube large end seal and small end seal note
h1.zh: 《液压工程》决定这篇S-tube large end seal and small end seal笔记的次序

directAnswer.en: The short answer for S-tube large end seal and small end seal uses the cells Xingtai already printed. Hydraulic engineering is the outline those cells are filed under. An S-tube seal from Hebei Pinjin Machinery is a set for one end of the S-tube. Large end and small end are both on the same product page and they are not interchangeable rows. No pump model is named.
directAnswer.zh: S-tube large end seal and small end seal的简答只用邢台已经印出的格子。《液压工程》是这些格子所依的大纲。 河北品锦机械的 S 管密封是 S 管一端用的套件。大端和小端写在同一张产品页上，但不是可以互换的行。没有点名泵型号。

body.en: The heading “Fundamental principles” is structural. What it is allowed to carry is the wording already on the row for this note. Large end: φ210, φ220, φ250. The φ220 row includes six-piece kits. Small end: φ80, φ90, φ100, φ105. The page also says some large-end kits are six-piece sets. the size row that states this is φ220. Material and life are missing. φ80 here is a small-end seal, not the DN80 clamp and not Electric 20's 80 mm pipe. φ100 here is not the 100 / 125 mm pipe cell. A swing-cylinder seal also uses φ80 and φ90 on its own page. No neighbouring page’s figure is copied onto this row.
body.zh: 标题“来源章节：Fundamental principles”只起骨架作用。它能够携带的，是这篇笔记对应那一行已经印出的文字。 大端：φ210、φ220、φ250。φ220 那一行包含六件套。小端：φ80、φ90、φ100、φ105。页面还说部分大端为六件套。 写明这一点的尺寸行是 φ220。材料和寿命缺失。 这里的 φ80 是小端密封，不是 DN80 管卡，也不是电动20的 80 mm 管子。这里的 φ100 不是 100 / 125 mm 管径格。摆缸密封在自己的页面也使用 φ80 和 φ90。 不把旁边那一页的数字抄到这一行。

body.en: “Applications” is a heading on the crawled page, used here only as the section name. It does not create a measurement. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Write large end or small end before the diameter. An S-tube seal from Hebei Pinjin Machinery is a set for one end of the S-tube. Large end and small end are both on the same product page and they are not interchangeable rows. No pump model is named. The page lists the ends as separate rows. It does not print a combined two-end kit. No neighbouring page’s figure is copied onto this row.
body.zh: “用途”是抓到的那一页自己的章节名，这里只拿来当标题，不另造一个测量值。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 在直径前面写明大端或小端。 河北品锦机械的 S 管密封是 S 管一端用的套件。大端和小端写在同一张产品页上，但不是可以互换的行。没有点名泵型号。 页面把两端分成不同的行。没有印出两端合并的一套。 不把旁边那一页的数字抄到这一行。

body.en: The heading “History” is structural. What it is allowed to carry is the wording already on the row for this note. The φ220 large-end row. Do not copy that count onto φ210, φ250 or the small-end rows. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. A service life, a replacement-hour figure and a wear-rate table are not printed. Leave that field blank. The heading stops there. Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hydraulic_engineering
body.zh: 标题“历史”只起骨架作用。它能够携带的，是这篇笔记对应那一行已经印出的文字。 φ220 大端那一行。不要把这个件数抄到 φ210、φ250 或小端各行。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 使用寿命、更换小时和磨损速率都没有印出。这一栏留空。 标题到此为止。 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hydraulic_engineering
